entry.title: New: dsh-ui-agents-pixe
entry.summary: Adds a "Work Roles" tab and a pixel-art office overlay to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: 508 built-in role cards (The Agency 255 + agency-agents-zh 253) with search, EN/ZH toggle and department filter; draggable Canvas 2D pixel characters that stand, type and pace, with idle chat that can plug into AI. One-command npm install, no dsh source changes. Exact install spec: dsh-ui-agents-pixe. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
